meaning: When a post, video, or photo gets shared by many people very fast.
clues: It is about something online that gets a lot of attention.
People pass it from one person to another.
It uses a word linked to germs, but here the word means popularity.
It can describe a post, video, photo, or other online item.
It has two words, and the second starts with V.

decoys.meaning: Being one of the topics talked about most on a site at a certain time.
An idea, joke, picture, or video that people pass around online.
An online headline or picture made to get your attention so you will click a link.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Before you share a popular post, pause and check who made it and when. Fast sharing does not prove it is true.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: A story could spread by word of mouth in my day. People still need to check a story before passing it along.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: If a post asks for private details or money, close it and check the claim elsewhere.

blank.sentence: So many people passed her cat video along so fast that it started ___.

why: Fast sharing does not prove a post is true, so check before you pass it on.
short: Shared by many people very fast

situations.text: A post everyone is sharing asks you to send private details or money to join in.
situations.why: Close it and check the claim somewhere else.
